subject: [RFC PATCH v2 13/18] mm/filemap: read from the page cache without folio references

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch improves the page cache read performance by allowing reads to occur without taking a reference on the folio, reducing the bounce of refcounts between CPUs. It achieves this by copying data from folios that are about to be freed under RCU read lock and using a batch size of up to 512 KiB per section. The patch also optimizes large folios and introduces checks for poisoned pages, uptodate status, and other conditions that require the slow path. This approach aims to reduce overhead and improve performance in scenarios with multiple CPUs accessing the same file.
